title: Gene Williams's look and his companions
summary: Gene as scholarly, nervous and ingratiating, often with Bill Colburn and Bill Russell.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: What kind of guy was Gene? What kind of fellow do you seem to be on a pair? Again, uh, just seeing him.

Well, he seemed to be a very scholarly-looking guy, uh, uh, pleasant-looking, kind of, maybe slightly on the nervous side. Uh, uh, he wore glasses, uh, kind of thin-faced, I suppose. An ingratiating smile. Uh.

Well, he had a couple friends. I suppose, uh, when Bill Colburn was in town, they were together a good deal at the time. Uh. Uh, and, uh, Bill Russell was, uh, with him a good deal at the time, as I recall, at first, uh, I mean, I, I'm not, I can't remember clearly when one would leave town or the other, you know. Uh-huh.
It didn't interest you then, I guess, too much either.
Well, I was, I was, yeah, I was so, uh, that's, uh, trying to keep track of so many things. Uh-huh.
